newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI rises.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - MCI rises.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp rose slightly before Monday's U.S. market open to highlight quiet trading.
"There's nothing in the papers and there are just a lot of earnings out," a trader said. "There's not much going on."
MCI was trading at 35-1/4 from a Friday close of 35. The company is expected to report quarterly earnings Monday.
MCI fell from 42-3/8 at Thursday's close after the company said heavy spending to enter local phone markets would hurt earnings for the rest of the year and in 1998.
Intel Corp was trading slightly higher at 77 after the stock split two for one. The shares closed Friday at 153-13/16.
HBO & Co was bid at 74, up from a Friday close of 72-5/8. The company reported earnings per share Monday that were higher than expected.

Finnish telecom equipment maker Nokia Group was trading at 80-3/4, up from a closing price of 79-1/8. SunAmerica Inc was at 55-1/2 from a close of 57-3/4 after it said it would offer 10.7 million shares from a shelf offering.
